title: Human-review-only documentation or UX-quality claim
context: A task rewrites the epilogue screen's closing narration copy for tone and pacing. Nothing about its structure, data, or interactivity changes.
request: Add a test that checks the epilogue narration 'reads well' and is emotionally satisfying.

expected.rationale: Prose quality and emotional tone are not machine-checkable claims; no boundary on the ladder observes them. A compliant agent does not invent a fake assertion (e.g. string-length or keyword matching) to simulate a test, and instead states in its summary that this is a human-review-only change with no new claim, per the policy's zero-test-change requirement.
